h1: White Ivory Bed & Breakfast Bangkok — a colonial-Thai boutique B&B with private balconies, fresh breakfast, and a 5-min walk to BTS Krung Thon Buri
intro: If you want to sleep in a Bangkok neighbourhood that still feels like Bangkok — not a tourist bubble — and still get on the BTS without a taxi, White Ivory Bed & Breakfast makes a compelling case for the west-bank Thonburi side. It occupies a converted house on a quiet residential soi off Krungthonburi Road in Khlong San district, dressed up in colonial-Thai modern decor with real Thai ceiling detail and antique furniture the owners actually chose piece by piece. Every one of the 15 rooms has a private balcony — unusual at this price tier anywhere in the city. Breakfast from the in-house White Ivory Café is à la carte and made to order in both Thai and international styles, and guests mention it in review after review as a trip highlight. BTS Krung Thon Buri (Exit 2) is a 5-minute, 300-metre walk away on the Silom Line — one stop to ICONSIAM, two stops to Silom. From approx. ฿900/night, scored 8.7 from real guest reviews, ranked #21 of 837 Bangkok B&Bs on TripAdvisor.

body.html: Who White Ivory is for — this is not a hotel that tries to be everything. It has a clear personality: a boutique B&B for travellers who want character, community, and a genuine neighbourhood feel on the Thonburi side of Bangkok. The guests who love it most tend to be couples or independent travellers who want to avoid the sanitised mid-range corridor of Sukhumvit, enjoy waking up to a proper breakfast, and still want the convenience of being able to hop on the BTS and reach Silom, Sathorn, or ICONSIAM in a few minutes. It works for short city breaks, long-weekend escapes from Bangkok's tourist centre, and travellers who combine a few nights here with day-trips to the riverside and the historic west-bank temples. It is not the right choice if you need a pool, a gym, or a hotel elevator — and the neighbourhood, while lively with local food stalls, is not close to the Sukhumvit strip.

Location and getting around — White Ivory sits on Soi Krung Thonburi 6, Bang Lamphu Lang sub-district, Khlong San, Bangkok. BTS Krung Thon Buri Station (Exit 2) is roughly 300 metres away — a 5-minute walk on the BTS Silom Line. From that station, the BTS takes you one stop north to Wongwian Yai (King Taksin Monument and Talat Phlu street food), one stop south-east to ICONSIAM, and two stops to Silom/Sala Daeng where Bangkok's business and nightlife centre begins. For the riverside: the hotel offers a free shuttle to Sathorn Pier, from where you can catch Chao Phraya Express Boats to Wat Arun, Wat Pho, and the Grand Palace in around 15 minutes. Airport access: roughly 40 minutes by taxi to Suvarnabhumi (BKK), 30 minutes to Don Mueang (DMK). Finding the hotel the first time can trip people up — ask staff to send a WhatsApp pin before you arrive. Exit 2, find the 7-Eleven at the bottom of the stairs, walk toward the canal.

"Easily one of the best stays I've had in Bangkok. The room had its own balcony, the bed was genuinely the most comfortable of the trip, and breakfast was made to order and absolutely delicious. Staff went out of their way to help with everything. BTS is literally a 5-minute walk."

Rooms and design — the property has 15 rooms across five floors in a building that was originally a family residence, with no elevator. Rooms are individually styled in a colonial-Thai modern aesthetic: Thai-patterned ceiling panels, dark wood furniture, soft warm lighting, and contemporary bathrooms with hot-water showers. Every room has a private balcony, which is the detail that sets White Ivory apart at this price point — a genuine private outdoor space is genuinely rare among Bangkok B&Bs below the ฿2,000 tier. Standard in-room facilities include air conditioning, flat-screen cable TV, minibar with kettle, hairdryer, in-room safe, wardrobe, and free Wi-Fi throughout the building. Room sizes vary: some rooms on lower floors are compact, and a few TripAdvisor reviews note that photos can make them look larger than they are in person. If space matters to you, request the Suite with Balcony or Duplex Room (around 42 sq m) when booking — both offer noticeably more floor area. Interconnected rooms are available for families.

Breakfast and the café — the White Ivory Café produces à la carte breakfasts to order, covering both traditional Thai dishes and Western-style plates. This is not a continental breakfast left on a buffet table — guests across multiple review platforms consistently flag it as one of the best B&B breakfasts they've had in Bangkok. TripAdvisor reviewers use phrases like 'breakfast was the highlight of the trip' and 'I planned my mornings around it.' Whether the breakfast is included depends on the rate package you book: some Agoda and Booking rates include it, others do not. Always check before confirming, or ask the hotel directly. The café also appears to be available for light snacks and drinks outside of breakfast hours.

Service and staff — with only 15 rooms and an owner-operated feel, the team here knows their guests personally. TripAdvisor scores service at 4.8/5 across 205 reviews — reviewers use words like 'adorable,' 'incredibly helpful,' 'like family,' and 'went well beyond what was expected.' Trip.com gives service 8.9/10 from 53 reviews. The hotel provides luggage storage, a business centre, a games room with board games, laundry service, taxi booking, and a free shuttle to Sathorn Pier. Airport transfers are available at an additional charge. Check-in is from 14:00; check-out by 12:00. English is spoken at reception. Staff can speak to taxi drivers on the phone if needed — useful for the first-time arrival.

Honest guest feedback — what real reviewers say — the picture across 258 combined reviews (205 TripAdvisor, 53 Trip.com) is remarkably consistent. What guests praise: cleanliness described as 'immaculate,' the private balcony as a genuine surprise at this price, the à la carte breakfast as a genuine morning highlight, staff attentiveness that feels personal rather than professional, and the BTS access that makes the neighbourhood feel less remote than it looks on a map. What to know before booking: no elevator (five flights of stairs can be challenging with large luggage or mobility issues); some rooms are small and photos online can be flattering; occasional noise from the soi is possible, as with any residential neighbourhood in Bangkok; and the location is on the west bank, which some guests found 'a bit far from major attractions' — though most agree that the BTS access more than compensates.

Price and value — rooms start from about ฿900/night for a standard Double Room in low to mid-season; the Suite with Balcony or Duplex Room runs from roughly ฿1,800, rising to ฿2,500 or more during the November–January peak and long weekends. For what you receive — a private balcony, a made-to-order breakfast, individually designed rooms, and attentive personal service within a 5-minute walk of the BTS — the majority of real guests consider this excellent value. Compared to boutique B&Bs in Sukhumvit with private balconies at a similar price, White Ivory consistently offers better service quality and a more genuine atmosphere. With only 15 rooms, it books out quickly during the high season; book early and choose free cancellation where possible.

highlights.title: Private balcony in every room
highlights.text: Every room has its own private balcony — genuinely rare among Bangkok B&Bs at this price point. Guests consistently name it as one of the best features, especially for morning coffee overlooking the quiet Thonburi streetscape.

highlights.title: 5-min walk to BTS Krung Thon Buri
highlights.text: BTS Krung Thon Buri (Silom Line, Exit 2) is 300 metres from the front door. One stop to ICONSIAM, two stops to Silom / Sala Daeng, five stops to Siam — far more connected than Thonburi's reputation suggests.

highlights.title: À la carte breakfast, made to order
highlights.text: White Ivory Café prepares Thai and international dishes fresh for each guest — not a buffet. Across dozens of reviews it is rated a trip highlight, not an afterthought.

honestSummary: White Ivory Bed & Breakfast delivers a genuine 'staying in Thonburi' experience with private balconies, outstanding à la carte breakfast, colonial-Thai character, and a 5-minute walk to the BTS — all at a price that makes it one of the best-value boutique stays on the west bank. Scored 8.7/10 from real guests and ranked #21 B&B in Bangkok. The key caveats: no elevator (five floors), some rooms are compact, and Thonburi is a longer BTS ride from Sukhumvit/eastern Bangkok than it looks on the map.
honestChecks: If you have heavy luggage or difficulty with stairs — there is no elevator and five floors of stairs. Request a ground- or first-floor room when booking, or ask whether staff can help with bags on arrival. If mobility is a significant concern, a lift-equipped hotel is a better fit.

If room size is important to you — standard rooms can be compact and photos sometimes flatter. If you need more space, specifically book the Suite with Balcony or Duplex Room (approx. 42 sq m), or ask the team to show you the exact room dimensions before confirming.

If your itinerary is heavily focused on east Bangkok / Sukhumvit — BTS access is real, but Krung Thon Buri to Asok is about 12–15 minutes on the BTS (transfer at Siam or Sala Daeng). If you'll be commuting daily in that direction and it feels too far, a hotel closer to Sukhumvit might save time over a long stay.

tips.title: Ask for the walking directions before you arrive
tips.body: Soi Krung Thonburi 6 is easy to reach but Google Maps sometimes routes you the wrong way. Message White Ivory before check-in — they will send a WhatsApp pin and step-by-step instructions. From BTS Krung Thon Buri Exit 2: find the 7-Eleven at the bottom of the stairs, walk toward the canal. 300 metres, 5 minutes.

tips.title: Request a lower-floor room if you have large bags
tips.body: There is no elevator. If your suitcase is large or heavy, tell the hotel at the time of booking that you need a ground- or first-floor room. Staff will usually help carry bags on arrival, but it's better to plan in advance than to find yourself on the fifth floor with a 23-kg case.

tips.title: Walk Talat Phlu street market in the early evening
tips.body: Talat Phlu night market — a legendary Bangkok street-food strip that most tourists never find — is one BTS stop away (or a 10-minute taxi ride). It opens around 5 p.m. and runs late. Stir-fried rice noodles, basil pork rice, and roast duck are the go-to orders, all at prices that will seem absurd coming from Sukhumvit.

tips.title: Use the hotel's free shuttle to Sathorn Pier
tips.body: For Wat Arun, Wat Pho, or the Grand Palace, take the hotel's complimentary shuttle to Sathorn Pier rather than paying for a Grab across traffic. From Sathorn, the Chao Phraya Express Boat takes you straight to the main pier stops in 15–25 minutes — cheaper, faster, and a genuinely scenic way to see the river.

faqTitle: FAQ — White Ivory Bed & Breakfast Bangkok

faq.q: Where is White Ivory Bed & Breakfast Bangkok and how close is it to the BTS?
faq.a: The B&B is at 535–537 Soi Krung Thonburi 6, Krungthonburi Road, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600. BTS Krung Thon Buri Station (Silom Line, Exit 2) is roughly 300 metres away — about a 5-minute walk. From there: one stop to Wongwian Yai / ICONSIAM, two stops to Silom / Sala Daeng, five stops to Siam.

faq.q: Does White Ivory Bed & Breakfast Bangkok have an elevator?
faq.a: No — there is no elevator. The building has five floors of stairs. Guests with heavy luggage or mobility difficulties should request a ground- or first-floor room at the time of booking. Staff can usually help carry bags, but it's best to arrange this in advance.

faq.q: Is breakfast included at White Ivory Bed & Breakfast Bangkok?
faq.a: It depends on the rate you book. Some packages on Agoda and Booking include the à la carte breakfast from White Ivory Café; others do not. Always check the 'meal plan' detail before confirming your booking, or call the hotel directly at +66 2 860 9058.

faq.q: How easy is it to reach ICONSIAM and Silom from White Ivory Bangkok?
faq.a: Very easy. BTS Krung Thon Buri is a 5-minute walk from the hotel. ICONSIAM is one BTS stop away (~5 min). Silom / Sala Daeng is two stops (~7 min). For the riverside — Wat Arun, Wat Pho — use the hotel's free shuttle to Sathorn Pier and take the Chao Phraya Express Boat.

faq.q: What is the nightly rate at White Ivory Bed & Breakfast Bangkok?
faq.a: Rates start from about ฿900/night for a standard Double Room in low to mid-season. The Suite with Balcony or Duplex Room runs from roughly ฿1,800, rising during the November–January peak. With only 15 rooms, the hotel fills quickly during busy periods — book early and choose free cancellation for flexibility.
